definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the upper arm bone to the shoulder. It allows the arm a wide range of movement in many directions.

examples.japanese: {肩|けん}{関節|かんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めた→痛める：13613_itameru⟧。
{肩|けん}{関節|かんせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かせる→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The shoulder joint can move through a wide range.

examples.english: Repeated pitching places a great strain on the shoulder joint.

notes:
Composed of {肩|けん} (shoulder) + ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧ (joint). An anatomy term; in this compound ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ takes its on'yomi けん rather than the everyday reading かた.

USAGE:
- {肩|けん}{関節|かんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧: to injure the shoulder joint
- {肩|けん}{関節|かんせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: the shoulder joint dislocates
The shoulder joint has the widest range of motion of any joint in the body, which also makes it relatively prone to dislocation and injury.
